about: Recurring cast of Ted type 2 (format "cdesign"), drawn by shorts/design_kit/ted2-cast.jsx: <T2Bust who="sam" x={486} y={1150} T={T} mood="nervous" s={1} /> inside art.jsx (972×1728 card). Moods: calm, happy, nervous, shocked, sad, smug, angry. Use a cast member whenever a scene needs a person; props, objects and extra figures are still drawn per video in the Rename Your Nerves style. Append each episode to the character's history.
style: Flat shapes, no outlines, egg-shaped faces, ink hair, white eyes with ink pupils, soft blush, a big soft coloured circle behind the subject. Reference: shorts/rename-nerves, shorts/styles/ted2/cast-sheet.jpg.

sam.name: Sam
sam.look: swept ink hair, cream shirt, blue backdrop
history: ep 1 (friend-question): stuck for weeks on quitting his job; answers instantly when asked what he would tell a friend (Solomon's paradox)
ep 2 (milgram-obedience): sure he'd have stopped; plays the volunteer at the panel, then refuses and says no out loud (Milgram 1963)
ep 3 (maximizer-test, with Leo): forty tabs for one phone charger; a maximizer (Schwartz et al. 2002); still wonders about tab 39; learns to define good enough

ep 4 (sam-see-through, with Grace): shaking hands before a speech, sure everyone can see; illusion of transparency (Savitsky & Gilovich 2003: audiences saw less nerves; speakers told about it gave better-rated talks); walks on calmer

ep 5 (sam-waiting-reply, with Priya): staring at "Read 9:14", would rather get a no; uncertainty is the stress (de Berker et al. 2016: 45 volunteers, a 50% shock chance was more stressful than 0% or 100%); Priya flips his phone: "you're not needy"
ep 6 (priya-urgent-emails): sticks a "BIG THING FIRST" note on Priya's laptop

priya.name: Priya
priya.look: long dark hair, mustard top, red backdrop
priya.personality: sharp, confident; knows the trick and explains it
history: ep 1 (semantic-satiation, with Leo): explains the tired-meaning idea behind semantic satiation
ep 2 (because-copier): explains that "because" sounds like a reason, so we stop checking
ep 3 (milgram-obedience): cameo as one of the two volunteers who refuse
ep 4 (lower-voice, with Grace): pitching to lead her team, every sentence ends like a question; learns voice-pitch study (Klofstad, Anderson & Peters 2012), ends sentences going down
ep 5 (omar-knew-it, with Omar): scrolls back to Omar's "no chance" text and hands him a notebook for his guesses
ep 6 (sam-waiting-reply): flips Sam's phone face down: "you're not needy, you hate a coin flip"
ep 7 (priya-urgent-emails, with Sam): answers twenty emails while the big project gathers dust; mere urgency effect (Zhu, Yang & Hsee 2018: 31% took the urgent 3-chocolate task over 5)

leo.name: Leo
leo.look: orange curls, freckles, teal hoodie, yellow backdrop
leo.personality: cheerful, impulsive; falls for every bias first
history: ep 1 (friend-question): cameo as "the friend" in the study scene
ep 2 (semantic-satiation): says "spoon" until it is just a noise; tries it on his own name tag
ep 3 (because-copier): cuts the copier line with "because I have to make copies"
ep 4 (maximizer-test): buys the first good charger in two minutes — the satisficer
ep 5 (sam-see-through): cameo as the student giving a speech on the spot
ep 6 (leo-ten-minutes, with Grace): "ten minutes" for his essay at 7 PM, still going at midnight; planning fallacy (Buehler, Griffin & Ross 1994: thesis guessed 33.9 days, took 55.5; worst case 48.6)

grace.name: Grace
grace.look: grey bun, round glasses, purple cardigan, teal backdrop
grace.personality: wise retired therapist; calm voice of reason
history: ep 1 (friend-question): Sam's neighbour; asks him "what would you tell a friend?"
ep 2 (milgram-obedience): names obedience to authority
ep 3 (gratitude-visit): hands Omar the pen; explains the boost lasted a month, faded by six; "so write another one"
ep 4 (lower-voice): nods at Priya's new pitch
ep 5 (sam-see-through): tells Sam the audience can't see his nerves (much)
ep 6 (leo-ten-minutes): shows Leo his last essay took 2 hours: "use last time, not hope"

omar.name: Omar
omar.look: buzz cut, full beard, red top, orange backdrop
omar.personality: competitive and proud; habits, motivation, status
history: ep 1 (because-copier): next in line at the copier; refuses Leo with no reason, then steps aside for an empty "because" (Langer copy-machine study)
ep 2 (gratitude-visit, with Grace): thinks thank-you notes are for weddings; writes to his old coach and reads it aloud, voice cracking (gratitude visit, Seligman et al. 2005)

ep 3 (omar-knew-it, with Priya): yells "I knew it!" after the match, but last week texted "no chance"; hindsight bias (Fischhoff & Beyth 1975: after Nixon's 1972 trips, people remembered giving higher odds to what happened); starts writing his guesses down
